# @mission-platform/forge-router-web-components

Forge router target for framework-free Web Components

## Installation

Add it to a consuming workspace member:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@mission-platform/forge-router-web-components": "workspace:*"
  }
}
```

## Usage

```ts
import { forgeRouterWebComponents } from '@mission-platform/forge-router-web-components';
```
